name: mu-payroll-social
description: Mauritius payroll and social contributions for 2026. Covers PAYE under the cumulative system, Contribution Sociale Generalisee (CSG), National Savings Fund, training levy, the Portable Retirement Gratuity Fund, end of year bonus, directors fees, car benefit, the joint monthly return, the Return of Employees, self-employed contributions, penalties and interest. Use for running a Mauritius payroll, employer on-costs, PAYE or CSG questions, or MRA employer returns.
